review.method: Whisper small and large-v3-turbo checked against all 33 original caption detection strips and the full movie contact sheet. Visible source captions take precedence over ASR errors.
review.false_positive_reason: These strips contain only the scene border, with no caption or speaker text.
review.timing: Consecutive identical caption fragments combined. Speech timings from turbo ASR supplement incomplete visual detections. First cue begins at audio time zero; source video begins at PTS 0.045967. Visual extents are shifted by that amount. Shared cue boundaries prevent overlaps. Preview timing still needs playback review.
uncertainties: The short speaker label on source segment 18 can refer to Sara Kodama or Sala Tyrrell. The movie does not show a portrait. Sara is retained as a short-label transliteration without assigning a full identity; verify the voice or scene speaker metadata before finalizing.
The source does not identify the agent who used the resonance energy. The translation preserves that omission with passive wording.
The thing that has opened in Hayato's line is not named in that caption. The translation preserves this instead of adding a gate or portal.
